Other Maintenance
Expense
(Establishment and

Expenditure)
column7:
Reduction in
provision of ₹273.00
lakh was the net effect
of increase of
₹295.20 lakh and
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹568.20 lakh. Increase
was attributed to need
of additional amounts
in electricity charges
head. Decrease was
attributed to
anticipated saving.
Reasons for final
saving have not been
intimated (July 2024).
